text: The customer wants to return only the bulb pack (₹899) from order LM-48001, keeping the plug (₹2,499). So far, the agent explained that a ₹50 restocking fee applies to opened packs under company policy, bringing the total refund to ₹849, and the customer agreed to proceed. Next, the agent needs to process the partial return and issue the ₹849 refund.
